description: External network egress allowlist. Deny by default. Adding entries requires Plan + Design + security review.
policy: Module group F (telemetry/cc-bridge/docs-code-scanner) and cc-regression (group E) must produce zero matches against blocked_patterns outside exempt_paths.
exempt_rationale: Test fixtures may mock or exercise external transport. Production node_modules NOT exempt (supply-chain risk, council security HIGH-2).
